context_for_next_testing_agent: Deal Presentation Canonical (Ficha Canonica Orquestada) fully tested. The new orchestrator at GET /api/deals/{dealId}/presentation returns per-module states instead of binary visibility. Key response fields: modules (with state per module), deal_summary (sanitized), financial_data (multi-year + CAGR), process_timeline, actions_panel (recommended/available/blocked). Frontend route /explorar/:dealId now points to DealPageCanonical which renders all 14+ modules with appropriate lock overlays and CTAs. Module states: open, preview, preview_locked, contact_required, nda_required, plan_required, hidden_only_if_no_data. Premium Intelligence Agent (Phase 4) is placeholder - premium_modules shows available=true for Pro+ with NDA but actual analysis not implemented.
